artifact.reason.compression: fast fall and fast recovery, {min} min, overnight
artifact.reason.dip: sudden drop of {drop} {unit} for {n} readings, then back to the earlier level
artifact.why.fast_fall: faster than interstitial glucose usually falls
artifact.why.gap_low: signal gap next to the low
artifact.why.decline: declined {drop} {unit} over the half hour before (real lows usually decline gradually)
artifact.why.activity: during an activity (real fast falls happen in exercise)
artifact.why.recurrence.one: similar low near this hour on {n} other night
artifact.why.recurrence.other: similar low near this hour on {n} other nights
artifact.why.fall_rate_fast: fell {rate} {unit} per min, faster than interstitial glucose usually falls
artifact.why.returned: returned to within 10 mg/dL of the earlier level
artifact.note.excluded.one: Time below range is {clean}% with {n} suspected sensor artifact left out ({all}% as recorded).
artifact.note.excluded.other: Time below range is {clean}% with {n} suspected sensor artifacts left out ({all}% as recorded).
artifact.note.flagged.one: Time below range is {all}% as recorded and {clean}% without the {n} suspected sensor artifact.
artifact.note.flagged.other: Time below range is {all}% as recorded and {clean}% without the {n} suspected sensor artifacts.
artifact.note.hint: Nothing is left out; choose “exclude” under Settings → Overview page to leave them out.

artifact.notice.link: Mark it real or not real on the Overview
artifact.mode.label: Suspected sensor artifacts
artifact.mode.help: Compression lows and sudden sensor dips are flagged on the Lows and highs card. “Flag only” keeps every number as recorded; “Exclude” also leaves them out of the statistics. You can always mark a low as real or not real by hand.
